content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages serves as a powerful, cost-effective hosting solution for digital product stores. It enables creators to showcase and sell items like ebooks, templates, and courses without the burden of platform fees or restrictions. Unlike services like Gumroad, which can charge up to 10% on sales, using GitHub Pages with NOWPayments significantly reduces transaction costs to just 0.5%. This setup not only empowers creators to retain more of their earnings but also ensures they maintain full ownership of their products and customer data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture involves several components working in harmony. GitHub Pages hosts your storefront, offering a simple and free way to display products. Google Apps Script manages the backend logic, automating order processing and product delivery. NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency transactions, providing instant payment verification without requiring customer accounts. This infrastructure is designed to be straightforward yet robust, allowing creators to operate their online stores efficiently without ongoing fees or reliance on external platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators in areas where traditional payment gateways are either unavailable or inefficient. Artists, educators, and entrepreneurs in countries like Pakistan, Venezuela, and Ethiopia can benefit immensely from a system that offers low-cost, high-efficiency options for selling digital products. By using GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, these creators can bypass the hurdles posed by international payment restrictions, making it easier to share their work with a global audience.
GitHub Pages offers free hosting with no hidden fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this architecture include GitHub Pages for hosting, which offers a user-friendly interface for setting up a product store. Google Apps Script provides the logic for handling orders and delivery automatically. NOWPayments enables seamless cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring that creators can receive payment without traditional banking hassles. Together, these elements create a cohesive system that empowers creators to run their businesses independently and effectively.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital product store, start by creating a GitHub account and setting up GitHub Pages for hosting your site. Next, write the code for your product pages, detailing each item you wish to sell. Integrate Google Apps Script to handle order processing and automate delivery. Finally, set up NOWPayments to manage crypto transactions, allowing customers to purchase using their preferred cryptocurrency. Within 48 hours, you can have a fully functional store up and running, ready to serve your audience.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using platforms like GitHub Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This architecture allows you to retain full ownership of your sales and significantly reduce transaction fees compared to traditional platforms. With a low fee of 0.5%, you can keep more of your earnings.
NOWPayments allows you to accept crypto with minimal costs.

If you’re looking to sell ebooks or templates without relying on PayPal or Gumroad, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is an ideal solution. It equips you with a ready-made setup using GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, ensuring you have a low-cost, efficient way to manage your digital store. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore options.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
